listing.name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Chaos Bleeds (Buffy Chaos Bleeds PC)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream ZIP includes launcher+game program; Install imports own Xbox ISO and optionally converts movies withFFmpeg(downloadable). It is a data installer around an existing runtime, not documented first-launch game compilation. Launcher owns self-update. AndroidAPK imports PALdisc. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream describes runtime, data installer, controls/saves/updater. Android USA unsupported. No independent complete playthrough or device qualification. Windows package plus Android ARM64 APK. Android13/Vulkan1.3 PAL-only unlike desktop supported disc variants; preserve per-platform revision constraint. Upstream platforms: Windows x64 and Steam Deck via Proton; Android 13+ ARM64 Vulkan 1.3 accepts PAL only, unlike desktop disc variants. Original data: Original Xbox Buffy Chaos Bleeds own ISO; Android requires PAL Europe. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
